import type { Context } from 'effect'
export type Frame = Readonly<{ runtimeContext: Context.Context<never> }>
const frames: Frame[] = []
export const setRuntime = (runtimeContext: Context.Context<never>): void => { frames.push({ runtimeContext }) }
export const requireRuntimeContext = (): Context.Context<never> => frames[frames.length - 1].runtimeContext
